from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, json, os

wt=Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/worktrees/rollout-zombie-fix")

def run(args, env=None):
    return subprocess.run(args,cwd=wt,text=True,capture_output=True,check=False,env=env)

probe=run(["python3","-c","import do_again.service.rollout as r; print(r.__file__)"])
test_head=(wt/"tests/test_rollout.py").read_text().splitlines()[:40]

snippet=r'''
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
import do_again.service.rollout as rollout
repo=Path("/tmp/do-again-rollout-zombie-probe")
rows=[
 {"pid":100,"ppid":1,"state":"S","command":"do-again daemon"},
 {"pid":101,"ppid":100,"state":"Z","command":"(git)"},
]
with patch.object(rollout,"runtime_layout") as rl,      patch.object(rollout,"service_status",return_value={"installed":True,"running":True,"pid":100}),      patch.object(rollout,"_request_state",return_value={"pending_requests":[],"started_requests":[]}),      patch.object(rollout,"_shared_browser_child_pids",return_value=set()):
    layout=rl.return_value
    from unittest.mock import MagicMock
    layout.state_dir=Path("/tmp/nonexistent-state")
    layout.runtime_source=Path("/tmp/nonexistent-runtime")
    layout.control_worktree=Path("/tmp/nonexistent-control")
    result=rollout.assess_upgrade(repo,process_rows=rows)
    print(result)
'''
probe2=run(["python3","-c",snippet])

print(json.dumps({
 "module_probe":{"stdout":probe.stdout,"stderr":probe.stderr,"rc":probe.returncode},
 "test_head":test_head,
 "behavior_probe":{"stdout":probe2.stdout,"stderr":probe2.stderr,"rc":probe2.returncode},
 "diff":run(["git","diff","--","src/do_again/service/rollout.py","tests/test_rollout.py"]).stdout,
},indent=2))
print("ROLLOUT_ZOMBIE_TEST_FAILURE_DIAGNOSTIC_OK")
